tsa-a19-v01.quick_english: Now, for those standing in lower doctrines, even up to gurus — immediately after death, solely by the power-descent arisen for raising the dead, let him perform the initiation called the final sacrament; and for those standing in higher doctrines, who have lost their observance and performed no expiation — thus is the Lord's command.

tsa-a19-v02.quick_english: Therein, whatever rite was told for raising the dead — all of it is to be done to the body: by the full oblation, the burning of the corpse-body. But for the deluded, to plant conviction, let him perform, with the force of ritual-knowledge-yoga, a trust-bearing funeral rite; therein, on the corpse-body, having placed mantras in the withdrawing order, having drawn them in by the net-sequence, having done curbing-piercing-rubbing and the rest, let him do, by the breath-moving sequence, in heart, throat, forehead — and lo, the corpse-body trembles.

tsa-a19-v03.quick_english: Then, having made the joining with the supreme Śiva, let him burn it with the full oblation; for the purified by funeral, and for the others too — or: a three-day śrāddha-initiation: on the fourth day, month by month, year by year, let him perform it.

tsa-a19-v04.quick_english: Therein, having performed the rite ending in oblation, having made a food-offering in one hand, having meditated on his power of virile form, knowable-formed, that has attained identity with the knowable-power present in the beast — let him offer it to the Lord as enjoyer. Thus, when knowable-being ceases, he becomes the Lord himself. Whether by funeral-raising-śrāddha-initiations one has succeeded or not, still, for one desiring enjoyment, multitude of rites for multitude of fruit — thus, let him perform all.

tsa-a19-v05.quick_english: Even of the liberation-seeker, for the attainment of made-of-That-ness, this — of the living, daily, like sustained practice.

tsa-a19-v06.quick_english: But for the knower of reality, no rite here ending in funeral and śrāddha is of any use: his death is a festival day for those continuing his knowledge-lineage, from the filling of consciousness-portion — of so much lineage, since the sole reality is mere consciousness — like the day of the lineage's attainment of knowledge while living.

tsa-a19-v07.quick_english: But everywhere here, in the śrāddha rite, image-abandonment is chief — so holds the revered Siddhāmata; and its rule will be told in the exposition of the occasional.

tsa-a19-v01.speaker: Teacher (post-mortem admission)
tsa-a19-v01.question: Who is initiated after death?
premises: For those standing in lower doctrines, even up to gurus — immediately after death.
Solely by the power-descent arisen for raising the dead: the final-sacrament initiation.
And for higher-doctrine men who lost observance and skipped expiation — thus the Lord commands.
tsa-a19-v01.inference: Even the unqualified dead qualify: power-descent alone admits, immediately after death, to the final sacrament.

tsa-a19-v02.speaker: Teacher (corpse-rite)
tsa-a19-v02.question: How is the rite done on the body?
premises: Whatever raising-rite was told — all of it to the body: full-oblation corpse-burning.
For the deluded, a trust-bearing funeral to plant conviction.
Net-drawn mantras, curbing-piercing-rubbing, breath-moving through heart-throat-forehead — till the corpse-body trembles.
tsa-a19-v02.inference: The corpse is worked like a ritual ground: burned, convinced, net-drawn, curbed, breathed into trembling.

tsa-a19-v03.speaker: Teacher (joining)
tsa-a19-v03.question: What then?
premises: Having made the joining with supreme Śiva, burn with full oblation.
For purified and others too — or a three-day śrāddha-initiation, fourth day, monthly, yearly.
tsa-a19-v03.inference: Joining done, burning done, on schedule: third-day śrāddha-initiation, monthly, yearly.

tsa-a19-v04.speaker: Teacher (offering)
tsa-a19-v04.question: What is offered, to whom?
premises: Oblation-ending rite, food in one hand, virile-formed knowable-power attained to beast-identity — offered to the Lord as enjoyer.
Knowable-being ceased, he is the Lord; succeeded or not, multitude of rites for the desirer.
tsa-a19-v04.inference: The offering is imagined into identity and given to the Lord as enjoyer; success or not, the enjoyer gets rites upon rites.

tsa-a19-v05.speaker: Teacher (daily)
tsa-a19-v05.question: And the living?
premises: Even the liberation-seeker's: this made-of-That attainment.
Of the living, daily, like sustained practice.
tsa-a19-v05.inference: Even the liberation-seeker practices daily, like sustained observance, toward made-of-That-ness.

tsa-a19-v06.speaker: Teacher (knower)
tsa-a19-v06.question: What of the knower's death?
premises: But for the knower of reality, no funeral-to-śrāddha rite is of use.
His death is festival day for his knowledge-lineage — consciousness-portion filling, lineage all mere consciousness, like knowledge-attainment day while living.
tsa-a19-v06.inference: The knower needs no funeral-to-śrāddha machinery: his death feasts his lineage with consciousness itself.

tsa-a19-v07.speaker: Teacher (seal)
tsa-a19-v07.question: What holds, and what comes next?
premises: Everywhere here, in the śrāddha rite, image-abandonment is chief — so holds the revered Siddhāmata.
And its rule will be told in the exposition of the occasional.
tsa-a19-v07.inference: Image-abandonment ruled chief on Siddhāmata authority; its rule deferred to the occasional-rite exposition.

essence: The dead of any doctrine admitted: immediately after death, solely by raising-power-descent, to the final-sacrament initiation.
Whatever raising-rite was told, all done to the body: full-oblation burning, trust-bearing funeral, net-drawn mantras, breath-moving through heart-throat-forehead — till the corpse trembles.
Joining with supreme Śiva, burning with full oblation; for purified and others — or three-day śrāddha-initiation, monthly, yearly.

Food offered in one hand, virile-formed knowable-power meditated into beast-identity, given to the Lord as enjoyer: ceased knowable-being, become Lord — succeeded or not, rites upon rites for the enjoyer.
Even the liberation-seeker's made-of-That attainment, of the living, daily, like sustained practice.
But the reality-knower needs no funeral-to-śrāddha rite: his death feasts his lineage with consciousness itself.
Image-abandonment ruled chief on Siddhāmata authority; its rule deferred to the occasional-rite exposition.

rasa.dominant: śānta with karuṇa undertow (quiescence carrying compassion)
rasa.justification: Death rites performed without mourning: the dead raised, the deluded convinced, the knower feasted. Compassion without grief, order without haste.

sections.SUMMARY: The dead of any doctrine admitted: immediately after death, solely by raising-power-descent, to the final-sacrament initiation. Whatever raising-rite was told, all done to the body: full-oblation burning, trust-bearing funeral, net-drawn mantras, breath-moving through heart-throat-forehead — till the corpse trembles. Joining with supreme Śiva, burning with full oblation; for purified and others — or three-day śrāddha-initiation, monthly, yearly. Food offered in one hand, virile-formed knowable-power meditated into beast-identity, given to the Lord as enjoyer: ceased knowable-being, become Lord — succeeded or not, rites upon rites for the enjoyer. Even the liberation-seeker's made-of-That attainment, of the living, daily, like sustained practice. But the reality-knower needs no funeral-to-śrāddha rite: his death feasts his lineage with consciousness itself. Image-abandonment ruled chief on Siddhāmata authority; its rule deferred to the occasional-rite exposition.
sections.FUNCTION: Admits the dead of every rank, works the whole raising-rite on the body, then exempts the knower.
sections.KEY TERMS: mṛtoddhāra (raising-the-dead as power-act); antyasaṃskāra (final sacrament); śrāddhadīkṣā (oblation-feeding initiation); yojanikā (joining with supreme Śiva); bhoktṛ (enjoyer as the Lord); tanmayībhāva (made-of-That as daily attainment). mūrtiyāga (image-abandonment as chief); Siddhāmata (cited authority).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Follows the converts chapter: the dead join the lower-ordered as receivable; the knower ends needing nothing. Image-abandonment ruled chief; its rule deferred.
sections.BOUNDARY: No metaphysics of death argued; the rite is stated, the exemption noted.
sections.EXPLANATION: Death opens every door the living chapters guarded: lower doctrines, lost observances, unperformed expiations — all admitted immediately after dying, by power-descent alone, to the final sacrament. Then the body is worked without remainder: full-oblation burning, a trust-bearing funeral for the deluded, mantras net-drawn in withdrawing order, curbing-piercing-rubbing, breath moved through heart, throat, forehead — till it trembles. Joining made with supreme Śiva, the burning done with full oblation; for the purified and the rest, or else a three-day śrāddha-initiation on the fourth day, monthly, yearly. Food offered in one hand, the virile-formed power meditated into identity with the beast-present knowable — given to the Lord as enjoyer; knowable-being ceased, he is the Lord. Success or not, the desirer gets rites upon rites. Even the liberation-seeker keeps daily made-of-That-ness like sustained practice. But the reality-knower needs none of it: his death is feast-day for his lineage — consciousness-portion filling, lineage all mere consciousness, like knowledge-attainment day while living. Image-abandonment stands chief by Siddhāmata authority, and its rule is promised for the occasional-rite exposition.
sections.RELATED: Pradipaka ch.19 pattern (same translator's voice for mantra-counts and funeral vocabulary); Wallis śaktipāta (post-mortem eligibility as grace-act); no external translation witness — qa NEEDS_WITNESS expected.
